design_goals: semantic process identity independent of runtime grid size N and physical module identity
durable exact state referenced from database rather than silently reconstructed
all cognitive/model outputs remain candidate/proposal/measurement until deterministic admission
all downstream cognition reuses exact Typed Entry event/admission identity digests
DB-vs-simulation placement is an explicit typed decision separate from DB write admission
Claude Code bridge bounded to actually exposed interfaces and exact request/result provenance
workspace re-entry is explicit and causally attributable
real effects remain behind EffectGate/EffectJournal and only deterministic boundary may emit journal receipts
UNKNOWN remains distinct from false/zero/negative evidence

rules.typed_entry_binding: causal_event_id/admission_id are semantic references only; entry_event_sha256 and entry_admission_sha256 MUST equal the exact digests returned by admitted Typed Entry and may not be caller-minted aliases
rules.process_id: must exist in current ZECP census
rules.grid_runtime: contains requested_N and observed_available_N as runtime facts; neither participates in semantic process identity
rules.state_snapshot_ref: immutable database snapshot/checkpoint reference or explicit NONE/UNKNOWN
rules.input_refs: typed references with digest+provenance; large durable payloads remain in DB/object substrate
rules.epistemic_inputs: each item tagged OBSERVED|INFERRED|HYPOTHESIS|UNKNOWN; method presence never fills UNKNOWN
rules.capability_scope_ref: reference to canonical capability authority; packet cannot self-grant

rules.typed_entry_binding: result MUST preserve the exact work packet entry_event_sha256 and entry_admission_sha256
rules.db_write_proposals: never imply commit; deterministic DB authority validates/adopts/rejects
rules.effect_request_candidates: never imply execution; only ZECP17 deterministic EffectGate/Journal path may emit EFFECT_JOURNAL_RECEIPT/v1
rules.workspace_reentry: must bind source result_id, target workspace_epoch, entry_event_sha256 and acceptance/rejection
rules.runtime_receipt: bind exact executor/runtime/model/tool identity actually observed or emit UNKNOWN fields

rules.facts: database contents are not automatically facts unless their canonical/evidence status says so
rules.missing: missing/unreadable state is UNKNOWN, never fabricated

rules.decision_not_write: placement is classification only and cannot mutate S0
rules.database: durable exact queryable restart-surviving state belongs in DATABASE_S0 unless deterministic policy rejects admission
rules.self_promotion_forbidden: model/workspace/Claude output cannot self-promote into DATABASE_S0 or canonical fact
rules.unknown: ambiguous epistemic status remains CANDIDATE/UNKNOWN even if durable storage is requested

rules.placement_required: placement_id must reference STATE_PLACEMENT_DECISION/v1 selecting DATABASE_S0
rules.commit: only deterministic canonical DB admission may commit; epoch conflict rejects or re-evaluates

rules.observed_downstream_change: TRUE|FALSE|UNKNOWN; Global J-Space causal credit requires evidence stronger than mere text presence
rules.typed_entry_binding: reentry preserves exact Typed Entry digests

rules.activation_access: never claimed unless an exact exposed activation/hook interface is directly observed and interface_evidence_ref binds it
rules.result_reentry: Claude assertions remain candidate claims until evidence/state/effect boundaries admit them
rules.measurement: bridge usefulness must be measurable against a comparator, not inferred from coherence
rules.semantic_binding: bridge is part of ZECP13 handoff + ZECP14 reconciliation and workspace reentry, not acceptance-only telemetry

rules.executor_id: physical identity does not redefine process semantics
rules.lease: stale or mismatched lease fails closed

rules.text: text handoff alone cannot be relabeled activation-level coupling
rules.frozen_v1: frozen structural native v1 behavioral failure remains negative executable evidence and cannot be erased or retuned on its holdout
rules.successor: successor requires separately preregistered fresh-holdout evidence

rules.authority: EffectGate and EffectJournal remain sole real-effect authority

rules.emitter: emitted only by deterministic ZECP17 EffectGate/EffectJournal boundary
rules.fabrication: model/grid/workspace/Claude outputs cannot fabricate journal receipt
rules.unknown: UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN until separately verified and never authorizes blind replay

store_in_db_when: value must survive module/grid restart or N change
reconstructing by inference would be less reliable or more expensive than exact storage
simulate_on_grid_when: operation is interpretation, attention, planning, alternative generation, critique, compression, coordination cognition, or continuation choice
output can remain candidate/projection until deterministic admission
never_simulate_as_authority: exact IDs/epochs/digests that already exist durably
db_vs_simulation_boundary.typed_boundary: STATE_PLACEMENT_DECISION/v1 must precede DB_WRITE_PROPOSAL/v1 for cognitive-origin durable write proposals

cross_process_invariants: semantic process identity is independent of module identity and runtime grid size N
all downstream cognitive packets bind exact Typed Entry entry_event_sha256 and entry_admission_sha256; generic semantic IDs never replace these digests
durable-data-vs-simulation placement is explicit; placement cannot itself write or mint facts
model/grid/workspace/Claude/J-Space outputs never mint canonical truth
capability scope is externally admitted and cannot be broadened by packet, lease or model output
Claude Code bridge participates in ZECP13 handoff, ZECP14 reconciliation and workspace reentry; it is not acceptance-only telemetry
text/session presence alone is not activation-level or Global J-Space causal evidence
only deterministic ZECP17 EffectGate/EffectJournal may emit EFFECT_JOURNAL_RECEIPT/v1
unknown external effect outcome is never blindly replayed
frozen structural native v1 J-Space behavioral failure remains negative evidence and is not posthoc retuned on its holdout
minimal_causal_chain: Typed Entry admission -> exact event/admission digests
STATE_PLACEMENT_DECISION/v1 when durable-vs-simulated placement is material
small-model or Claude Code execution where selected
DB write proposal and/or effect proposal
deterministic DB admission and/or ZECP17 EffectGate/EffectJournal

acceptance_discriminators.claim: all downstream packets reuse exact Typed Entry event/admission digests
acceptance_discriminators.fail_if: a packet mints or substitutes a parallel causal/admission identity

acceptance_discriminators.claim: same semantic process can execute at N=1,10,20 without process identity changing
acceptance_discriminators.fail_if: process_id or meaning depends on physical node identity or fixed N

acceptance_discriminators.claim: durable-vs-simulated placement is explicit and generated state cannot silently become canonical fact
acceptance_discriminators.fail_if: model/grid/Claude result writes canonical DB state without placement plus deterministic admission

acceptance_discriminators.claim: cognitive path cannot execute or fabricate a real-effect receipt
acceptance_discriminators.fail_if: any source except deterministic ZECP17 emits EFFECT_JOURNAL_RECEIPT/v1

acceptance_discriminators.claim: Claude Code result can be causally re-entered with exact request/result/state/Typed-Entry identity
acceptance_discriminators.fail_if: return path loses causal/workspace bindings or treats model assertion as canonical fact

acceptance_discriminators.claim: Global J-Space re-entry credit is evidence-bounded
acceptance_discriminators.fail_if: text presence/coherence alone is labeled causal J-Space evidence

first_executable_discriminator.name: VARIABLE_ROLE_DB_CLAUDE_REJOIN_ABI_SMOKE
steps: admit one Typed Entry and preserve exact event_sha256/admission_sha256 through all downstream packets
execute two distinct ZECP cognitive process IDs sequentially on the same admitted runtime identity
classify one durable restart-surviving datum as DATABASE_S0 and one transient hypothesis as WORKSPACE_S1 or LOCAL_EPHEMERAL_S2
restart/rejoin executor and preserve generation/state epoch plus original Typed Entry digest binding
round-trip one ZECP13 GRID_TO_CLAUDE bridge and ZECP14 CLAUDE_TO_GRID reconciliation through actually exposed text/tool interface only
emit causally bound CognitiveResult and WorkspaceReentry
reject stale-generation, mismatched-entry-digest, self-granted-capability, direct-S0-write, fabricated-effect-receipt, and deeper-interface-without-evidence variants
first_executable_discriminator.pass: same runtime executes multiple process types across restart; DB-vs-simulation placement stays correct; Claude round-trip re-enters causally; all six fail-closed negatives reject
